name: BITEZ - D8 + D9 + THCP 2000MG Gummies - Sour Watermelon Apple
description:
Pucker up for a flavor explosion with Double-Stacked Sour Watermelon Apple gummies. Each 2-count pack 1,000mg per gummy with a powerful Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend. Two bold layers deliver juicy watermelon sweetness paired with tart green apple sourness for an irresistible sweet-and-sour combo. High-potency edibles meet mouthwatering flavor in every bite.

Sour Watermelon Apple layers juicy Watermelon with tart Apple flavor, packing 2,000mg per bag and 1,000mg per gummy. Each gummy features a potent blend of THCP, Delta-9, and Delta-8 for a stacked BITEZ experience.
